selection.ownership: Fern Money (fernhq.com), New York / Delaware, acquired by Rain (rain.xyz) on 2025-12-02. The reviewed edition is the public REST API at https://api.fernhq.com, not a mainland-China product. Distinct from buildwithfern.com (API docs tooling) and the Fern YouTube channel.

research.searchCoverage: Official Fern Developer API (Bearer API keys, https://api.fernhq.com, GET /customers, GET /customers/{id}, GET /payment-accounts/{id}, GET /transactions/{id}), dashboard key creation, Rain acquisition announcement, New York operator identity, and dated incident search (Fern HQ / Fern Money + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Unrelated YouTube/docs-tooling Fern hits excluded. No qualifying unresolved Fern Money customer-account compromise identified. Not a breach-free claim.

Official Fern API at https://api.fernhq.com with Bearer API keys. Customer, payment-account, and transaction reads confirmed against pinned source and official OpenAPI on 2026-09-13. Exchange-rate quotes omitted as they are quote/pricing reads. Dated incident search found no qualifying unresolved Fern Money compromise. Not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /customers?pageSize=1, matching the pinned source credential probe. This is a cheap authenticated list, not a billable quote or search.
Optional pageSize (1-100) and pageToken bind to documented query names. organizationId is omitted. Provider nextPageToken is never followed automatically.
customerId is encoded as the /customers/{customerId} path segment. includeVerification and includePaymentMethods query flags are omitted.
paymentAccountId is encoded as the /payment-accounts/{paymentAccountId} path segment.
transactionId is encoded as the /transactions/{transactionId} path segment. Quote creation and transaction writes are omitted.
POST /transactions creates a transaction from a quote.
